limits: Observed acceptance is for this synthetic hybrid local-Certify/Collab-Verify configuration and reported Android build.
Installed APK SHA-256/signing identity and exact source build are not independently attested; Mac APK copy identity is recorded separately.
Collab Verify running version remains unreported; no certificate-chain trust or general conformance claim.
Request queried credential type, not an isolated native selective-disclosure policy; no specific native claim-disclosure behavior is claimed.
Native internal key operations and raw direct-post traffic were not captured; proof validity is verifier-reported.
Wallet success screen uses Unknown Verifier as its display name, while the consent screenshot identifies Collab DID as Trusted. No display-name diagnosis or upstream defect is asserted.
Original Collab OAuth client rejection and pre-authorized HTTP401 remain separate historical findings.
No raw credential, presentation, offer code, private key, token or complete session URI is committed.
